children: Vancouver, B.C. – October 26, 2026 – TheNewswire – West Mining Corp. (“West Mining” or the “Company”) (CSE: WEST)

is pleased to announce that it has completed its previously announced (see West Mining’s news release dated October 8, 2026) sale of the Junker Property pursuant to a property purchase agreement with Hi-View Resources Inc. (“Hi-View”; CSE: GXLD) and Zeal Exploration Inc. (Hi-View’s wholly-owned subsidiary) dated as of October 1, 2026. As consideration for the Property, West Mining received a cash payment of $7,500 and an aggregate of 125,000 Hi-View common shares, with each share subject to a four month hold period expiring February 23, 2027 in accordance with applicable securities laws and the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange.

West Mining Corp. is a mineral exploration company currently exploring for copper, gold and silver on its 100% owned Spanish Mountain West Property in central British Columbia. West Mining also holds a 100% interest in the Kena Property, which it has optioned to Upside Gold Corp.
For additional information, please refer to the Company's public disclosure record available on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.com.
